description: Update an existing heir's details. Use when the user wants to correct or add information to a recorded heir. Get the heir_id from the pre-loaded Heirs context block.

address.description: Updated mailing address (empty string clears it)

email.description: Updated email address (empty string clears it)

estate_id.description: The estate to act on. Call list_my_estates first to get this id.

heir_id.description: ID of the heir to update

is_divorced.description: For a spouse only: whether they are a divorced/former spouse (not a surviving spouse).

name.description: Updated name exactly as the customer gave it. Never add a last name or any part they didn't give.

name_from_document.description: true when the new name was read from a document the customer shared rather than typed by them.

notes.description: Updated free-text notes about this heir (empty string clears). Use for context like whereabouts unknown, predeceased details, per-stirpes notes, disputes, or anything the user wants remembered.

parent_heir_id.description: ID of the heir this person inherits through (e.g. a grandchild's predeceased parent). Use it to fix or add that link; empty string removes it.

phone.description: Updated phone number (empty string clears it)

relationship.description: Updated relationship to the deceased. Canonical values: spouse, child, stepchild, grandchild, parent, sibling, other. Free-text wording (e.g. 'half-brother') is accepted and normalized automatically. "My brother" is the customer's brother, not the deceased's: ask before changing it.

relationship_confirmed.description: Required when changing relationship: true only when the customer has said or confirmed this person's relationship to the deceased (not to themselves), in this conversation or in a document they shared.

relationship_detail.description: The relationship exactly as the user described it, when it carries more than the canonical value (empty string clears it). Shown on probate forms.

name: update_heir
